15.title: The End of Oak Street early reviews: Anne Hathaway’s bleak dinosaur thriller bites into 83% on Rotten Tomatoes
15.sentence: Mashable’s take. The outlet essentially imagines an Amblin movie made by someone considerably less interested in reassuring audiences, noting the film’s echoes of Jaws and Jurassic Park, including some deliberately recognisable sound and score choices.
